<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a simple series chain from node A to node B passing through the intermediate nodes in the order A → N_a1 → N_a2 → N_a3 → X1 → N_b1 → N_b2 → X2 → N_c1 → N_c2 → B. The resistor values are the differences between successive A‑to‑node resistances (or B‑to‑node resistances), giving R1‑R10 as 5 Ω, 10 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω, 10 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω, 10 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω. This topology reproduces every pairwise measurement, so it is the inferred circuit.</thought>
